description: Issue #859: reverts FileUploadOptions.EnforceTenantFileScope's default from true back to false (its pre-#859 value) -- a one-line value change, not a statement delete -- reproducing the exact pre-fix package behaviour: WtmFileProvider.GetFile calls IgnoreQueryFilters() on FileAttachment queries whenever the flag is left at its (mutated) default, so a file resolves by GUID regardless of which tenant uploaded it. This is the package half of #859's fix -- the part that reaches an existing deployment that upgrades and changes no config, independent of the demo template's IsFilePublic setting. Checked against FrameworkControllerFileScopeTests859.GetFile_Unauthenticated_IsFilePublicTrue_TenantOwnedFileBlocked_NullTenantFileServed, which deliberately opens the _Framework/GetFile route with an explicit IsFilePublic=true override (simulating an existing deployment that has NOT changed its own config after upgrading) while leaving FileUploadOptions:EnforceTenantFileScope unset so the test reads the actual compiled default -- with the mutant applied, the anonymous negative-control request for a tenant-owned FileAttachment succeeds and its body contains the seeded marker instead of being absent. The green control, GetFile_Unauthenticated_TemplateDefaultConfig_RejectedAndDoesNotLeakContent, seeds a NULL-tenant file and relies entirely on the template-half fix (IsFilePublic=false blocking the route via PrivilegeFilter before WtmFileProvider.GetFile is ever reached) -- a control genuinely orthogonal to this mutant's scope, not merely a different assertion on the same code path.
target_symbol: FileUploadOptions.EnforceTenantFileScope get/set property initializer (default value), line 55

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.FrameworkContro: #859: even with IsFilePublic=true \(an existing deployment that has not changed its config\), an anonymous caller must NOT be able to read a tenant-owned file by GUID
